fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Price.Override
fields.Description: Parent grant for changing an order line away from the engine price. Child authorizations are OverrideList (pick another named applicable price) and OverrideAny (type an amount).

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Price.OverrideList
fields.Description: Pick another named applicable price (product or inherited category, When-matching). UnitPrice must match that row. Does not allow typing an arbitrary amount.

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Price.OverrideAny
fields.Description: Type any unit price on an unbooked line. Implies OverrideList. Clears ProductPriceID (or records OverrideKind=Amount) and still writes the engine price on the component breakdown.
